children: Risks surrounding inflation in Sweden are not clear-cut, and economic growth may pick up without inflationary pressures rising significantly in the near term, central bank Governor Erik Thedeen said in a speech on Thursday.
"During the summer, inflation has been higher than the Riksbank's forecast in June, and there is uncertainty regarding what effect different supply shocks will have on consumer prices," he said.
"So far we do not see any clear signs of a lasting, broad upturn in inflation, but we must have a high level of vigilance with regard to rising inflation."
